newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL-Cephalon skids,techs strong.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL-Cephalon skids,techs strong.

text.p: Shares of Cephalon fell more than 40 percent in pre-opening trading after the biopharmaceutical's treatment for Lou Gehrig's disease was rejected by a U.S. Food and Drug Administration panel.
Shares were down 8-5/8 to 11-3/8, traders said. The FDA panel voted 6-3 against recommending approval of Myotrophin.
Chiron Corp was Cephalon's development partner.
Chiron shares were at 18-3/4 from their close at 20, the stock considerably less hurt than Cephalon's for the company's role in developing the drug to treat amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS).
Technology stocks showed strength, traders said, which could bode well for the opening of the Nasdaq.
Cisco Systems Inc was up 1 to 62-3/8. Intel shares were at 160-3/4 from their close at 158-3/4.
